info.name: Smart Campus Access Control - Final (Kubernetes)
info.description: Run top to bottom (Collection Runner, or one by one). Each run creates fresh test users and a room, and the last folder deletes them. Folders are labelled with the team member who owns that microservice.

item.name: 1. Registration [Boukheang]
item.description: Sign-up rules, admin user management, batch import.

item.name: Setup: admin login (creates fresh test data names)

exec: pm.test('No password hashes in response', () => pm.response.json().users.forEach(u => pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property('password')));

item.name: 2. Authentication [Boukheang]
item.description: Login issues a signed JWT (8h); wrong details give 401.

exec: pm.test('Token valid, email matches', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.valid).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.user.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('studentEmail')); });
pm.test('Generic message (no hint which part was wrong)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email, password, or role'));

item.name: 3. Room & Classroom Enrollment [Panhavan]
item.description: Rooms, faculty assignment, enrollment workflow, door lock.

item.name: 4. Student & Teacher portals [Panhavan]
item.description: Each user sees only their own profile and schedule.

item.name: Student: my room schedule (shows enrolled class)
Teacher: my room schedule (shows taught class)
5. Access Log - door swipes [Boukheang]
item.description: Door decisions and audit log. Responses carry X-Served-By-Instance (the pod name).

item.name: Swipe again -> served by a different pod (round-robin)
NEGATIVE: student claims to be admin in body -> logged as self

exec: pm.test('Swipe recorded under the real student', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().log.userEmail).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('studentEmail')));

item.name: Admin: audit log for this room
6. API Gateway [Sokhadom]
item.description: Single entry point: JWT check, role check, routing, round-robin load balancer.

item.name: NEGATIVE: forged X-User-Role: admin header is ignored -> 403
8. Emergency Alert [Sokhadom]
item.description: Incident reports and campus lockdown lifecycle.
